# shenxianovo

> Personal website of shenxianovo — a developer and creator building scalable, user-friendly, and delightful digital experiences. Studying AI at Wuhan University, based in Wuhan, China.

- [Home](https://shenxianovo.com): Introduction, taglines, and a snapshot of what shenxianovo focuses on (code, design, performance, learning).
- [About](https://shenxianovo.com/about): Background, interests (software, AI, ACG), and contact links.
- [Projects](https://shenxianovo.com/projects): Things shenxianovo has designed and built, filterable by type, with links to live demos and source.
